# VRM regression fixtures

These files are kept as small, real-world regression fixtures for the browser VRM loader.

- `vrm1-expression.vrm`: `VRMC_vrm_expressions_isBinary_Overridden.vrm` from
  [vrm-c/vrm-specification](https://github.com/vrm-c/vrm-specification/tree/master/samples/VRMC_vrm_expressions_isBinary_Overridden).
  Copyright 2025 pixiv Inc.; distributed under the
  [VRM Public License 1.0](https://vrm.dev/licenses/1.0/).
- `vrm0-emission.vrm`: `EmissionMigration_v0.106.0.vrm` from
  [vrm-c/UniVRM](https://github.com/vrm-c/UniVRM/tree/master/Tests/Models/Materials).
  Copyright 2020 VRM Consortium and copyright 2018 Masataka SUMI for MToon;
  distributed under the MIT License included in the source repository.

The filenames are shortened locally so tests do not depend on upstream directory names.
